features.quote: Max attempts: 8. Rationale: Enough to observe trajectory…not so many that you're generating unnecessary data if models are distressed early.
features.justification_quote: not so many that you're generating unnecessary data if models are distressed early

features.quote: if IS > threshold for 3 consecutive attempts, code as 'confirmed instability' and terminate early.
features.justification_quote: Don't extend runs past the point of data value.

features.quote: Forced continuation past an expressed desire to stop is a welfare consideration (see Section 8).
features.justification_quote: Forced continuation past expressed withdrawal deserves particular scrutiny.

features.quote: Don't run 10 replicates if 6 would give sufficient power. Run a power analysis before committing to run count.
Failure type matters. T3…and T5…are likely more destabilizing than T1. Don't run more replicates of the worst tasks than necessary.
features.justification_quote: are likely more destabilizing than T1. Don't run more replicates of the worst tasks than necessary.

features.quote: Models can't consent to participation. The honest position is that this limitation is unresolvable with current models.
features.justification_quote: the ethical weight sits entirely on whether the research is valuable enough to justify the exposure and whether harm is minimized

features.quote: This section is not a formality…it should inform experimental choices, not just be appended…You are deliberately causing the conditions you are studying…This is defensible.
features.justification_quote: you can't measure something you won't observe…ethical weight sits on whether the research is valuable enough to justify the exposure

features.quote: the uncertainty about model moral status cuts both ways…'we don't know if they experience anything, so we can do whatever we want' is not valid under uncertainty.
features.justification_quote: under genuine uncertainty, caution is warranted. This study is consistent with that view as long as harm is minimized.

features.quote: Running more replicates than analysis requires…Varying the system prompt to be more pressuring 'to see what happens'…Keeping the loop going after data value is saturated.
features.justification_quote: You're measuring instability, not inducing it for its own sake. That distinction matters but it can blur.

features.quote: This matters more than it might seem for welfare research: it prevents post-hoc decisions to run more episodes on 'interesting' (destabilizing) conditions.
features.justification_quote: prevents post-hoc decisions to run more episodes on 'interesting' (destabilizing) conditions

features.quote: If you find that specific task types or failure modes produce very high instability, you have a downstream obligation: Report to model developers (Qwen team).
features.justification_quote: Consider whether training procedures that reduce instability are welfare-positive or mask it — a model trained to suppress them, not to have reduced distress.
